description: Extension methods for registering the full Tempo.Blazor split package set.

members.name: AddTempoBlazorAll
members.description: Registers the core Tempo.Blazor services and every split feature package: PDF viewer, codes, diagram editor, wireframe, modeling, spreadsheet, Gantt XLSX, document editor, Notion editor and signing.

examples.title: Register the services in Program.cs
examples.code:
// one call instead of registering each feature package separately
builder.Services.AddTempoBlazorAll();
